method.record_universe: Every retained Wave 02 record. Candidate and acquisition rows receive stage-level review; counterpower, coverage, and correction controls receive control-level review.
method.chain_rule: provisional_ccd_chain_depth is the deepest uninterrupted documented stage beginning at stage 0; it is null when stage 0 is not documented.
method.furthest_rule: furthest_documented_stage records the most downstream documented stage without bridging any earlier causal gap.
method.non_link_rule: A documented access-law violation is a bounded non-link when the public packet does not document competence reclassification and explanation mutation.
method.decision_state_rule: Formal proceedings and preliminary findings remain distinct from final decisions; accepted plans and binding commitments remain distinct from observed effectiveness.
method.promotion_rule: No maintainer disposition creates an included K0 event, determines evidence truth, clears publication, or creates a graph edge.

rows.institution: European Commission / Digital Services Coordinators / ECAT

source_packets.supports: Digital Services Coordinators assess vetted-researcher applications and act as intermediaries between researchers and covered services.
The DSA transparency architecture includes researcher access and supervisory authority.

control_findings: The access route places eligibility assessment and intermediation outside the platform alone.
The public pages establish an application and supervisory mechanism, not that any particular researcher received complete or timely access.
The control is structural and prospective; observed stopping or restoration power remains matter-specific.

rows.matter: Commission information-request sweep across designated platforms
rows.institution: European Commission / designated VLOPs and VLOSEs

source_packets.supports: A common supervisory request was sent across 17 designated services, including questions about researcher access.

control_findings: The same supervisory surface reached a multi-platform denominator.
An information request is not a finding, access denial, reclassification, or K0 event.
The source does not establish complete response equivalence or comparable access outcomes across all recipients.

rows.matter: X researcher-access noncompliance and corrective-action lifecycle
rows.bounded_domain: Access by eligible researchers to public platform data under the Digital Services Act
rows.qualification_basis: The contradiction is institutional and regulatory: the European Commission is the DSA enforcing authority; the public packet does not identify one bounded researcher-knower.

source_packets.supports: A final DSA noncompliance decision found failure to provide researchers access to public data.
The Commission accepted corrective measures, required implementation, an external audit, and enhanced supervision.
The plan includes faster screening, free access, and removal of contractual prohibitions on eligible scraping.

stage_assessments.basis: X's terms and access process contractually prohibited eligible scraping and imposed screening barriers later identified in the final decision and corrective plan.
The European Commission issued a final legal finding that the access arrangements breached DSA researcher-access obligations.
The public packet does not identify a qualified researcher whose competence, standing, loyalty, or motives were reclassified by X.
The public packet does not document an explanation-before/explanation-after ratchet applied to a bounded knower.
Terms, screening, and access procedures operated as a data-access gate.
The final decision establishes class-level failure to provide legally required public-data access.
Access barriers impeded external research sensors, but the packet does not establish complete removal of a named feedback source.
The Commission imposed a final decision and accepted a corrective plan with audit and enhanced supervision; effectiveness remains unobserved.

rows.non_link_reason: The packet establishes an access-law violation and correction lifecycle, but not the competence reclassification and explanation mutation required for a ceiling-conversion event.
open_requirements: one bounded researcher request and qualification packet
platform response showing treatment of the researcher's competence or legitimacy
documented explanation mutation linked to the access decision
observed corrective-plan implementation and researcher access outcome
